title: The tour is not yet over , let's wait and see..
text: Saragoza so far was my beautiful town in it's harmony and tolerance from medieval to modern , a city of mystery, more to come..., the tour is still on..
author: NuwarJodeh

title: Great value tour
text:
Great tour, saw some great sights and great accommodation. Well organised.
Loved experiencing new places
author: Patricia_M

title: Excellent tour
text:
Second time I have tried to write this so it is going to be a lot shorter then my first.
Truly enjoyed. Nacho was an excellent guide and tried to keep us on track. Extremely pleased with the quality and location of the hotels, except two-Oviedo and La Corunna(especially the location). Busy days. Enjoyed the provided meals, if you have allergies let your guide or tour know. Amazing value!
author: Kjell_D

title: North Spain
text: Great trip to see north of Spain. Our driver was excelent, the best. This circuit does not include local guided tours for cities visited, this contrast to Andalusia vpt tour that included local guides. Accomodations, breakfasts and dinners were reassonable.
author: Fernando_J
